name: Hypotactic (David Chamberlain) - Greek and Latin verse with syllable-level scansion, website
contents: Syllable-by-syllable metrical tagging (quantity, elision, hiatus, synizesis, feet, caesura) of Greek and Latin verse. Greek: Homer, Hymns, Hesiod, Apollonius, Callimachus, Nonnus, Quintus; elegy/iambic (Solon, Semonides, Theognis, Tyrtaeus); all Pindar victory odes shown in stanza layout; several Aeschylus plays. SCS review (Conser 2022): drama and lyric are 'more limited'.
size: Website; Latin data zip 29 MB (28 JSON files, Latin only, 17 Jun 2025); Greek JSON release not yet published (author targets a versioned DOI release 30 Jun 2027)
licence: Homer page: 'Audio and text annotations licensed as CC-BY, (c) 2016, 2017 by David Chamberlain.' Author's own wording of the data licence is quoted in the Urdatorn/hypotactic README: 'All the data on this site is/are licensed as CC-BY 4.0 ... By "data" I mean the tagging of individual syllables of verse with metrical attributes'. I could NOT find that CC-BY 4.0 sentence on the live site pages I fetched (Welcome, About, Use-the-source, Data post): no licence stated there. The Latin zip contains no licence file.
value_why: Only open, human-checked, line-by-line scansion that covers Pindar (all 4 books), Solon, Semonides, Theognis, Tyrtaeus; directly feeds Melos scansion gold/validation.
effort_why: Use the GitHub mirror (next row) instead of scraping; pages are static HTML spans (class short/long, foot#, word#).
restrictions: Attribute David Chamberlain and hypotactic.com. Do not scrape the site (author invites 'use the source' but the mirror exists). Owner may want a one-line written confirmation from Chamberlain of the CC-BY 4.0 scope because the live site does not state it. Author warns caesura marking needs correction and scansion reflects subjective choices. robots.txt only disallows /wp-admin/.

name: Urdatorn/hypotactic - Chamberlain's Greek verse corpus as TSV/TXT (CC-BY-4.0 GitHub mirror)
contents: 88 TSV files (line text, scansion string like '-u- -- u---', genre tag e.g. 'lyric') plus HTML sources. Includes Olympians, Pythians, Nemeans, Isthmians, Solon, Semonides, Theognis, Tyrtaeus, Aeschylus Persians/Prometheus/Seven, Iliad, Odyssey, Hesiod, Hymns, Callimachus, Apollonius, Aratus, Nicander, Theocritus, Nonnus, Quintus, Lycophron, Tryphiodorus etc. Also adjust_syllabification/hypotactic_all_shuffled_cleaned.txt (60,660 re-syllabified lines).
size: 18.4 MB repo (cleaned txt 6.7 MB); last push 2026-08-17
licence: GitHub licence CC-BY-4.0; LICENCE file starts 'Attribution 4.0 International'. README: 'The corpus is published on the Hypotactic website under the CC-BY 4.0 licence' and quotes Chamberlain's interpretation.
value_why: Ready-to-ingest scansion of the very authors Melos covers (Pindar, Solon, Theognis, Semonides, Tyrtaeus); lets Melos check its own scansion against a human-annotated gold set.
effort_why: Plain TSV; main work is matching lines to Melos edition and line numbers (Chamberlain uses its own text editions).
restrictions: CC-BY 4.0: credit Chamberlain and hypotactic.com. Re-syllabification caveat: mute+liquid always split (README: 'many lines thus have bugs' for epic). Text editions behind the lines are Chamberlain's choices (Iliad: Monro and Allen 1920); line numbering may differ from Melos editions.

name: Chamberlain Iliad scansion as CSV (syllable per row)
contents: Full Iliad, one row per syllable with line, foot, word, hemistich fields (also Iliad books 1-12 zip at /wp-content/uploads/2016/11/IliadCSV.zip).
licence: No licence on the 'Use the Source' page. Homer page: 'Audio and text annotations licensed as CC-BY, (c) 2016, 2017 by David Chamberlain.'
value_why: Epic hexameter; Melos focus is lyric/elegy/iambus. Superseded by the TSV mirror.
restrictions: Author: 'I would not recommend using these for caesura statistics.'

name: Urdatorn/responsio-accentuum - accentual responsion in Pindar (44 polystrophic odes) and Bacchylides 5
contents: Software and data to mark and measure accentual responsion; scanned strophe/antistrophe lines in TEI-like XML (data/scan, compiled, compiled_doric, ht, cache). Pindar scansions partly derived from Hypotactic. Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20308875.
licence: Repo GNU GPL-3.0 (code). README: 'For Pindar, I am partly using scansions derived from the Hypotactic website, which is under the CC-BY 4.0 license.' No separate data licence stated.
value_why: Strophe-aligned, syllable-scanned Pindar and Bacchylides - exactly the responsion data a lyric reader needs (strophe/antistrophe side by side).
effort_why: Need to map custom XML and bracket markup ([long]{short}) onto Melos lines.
restrictions: GPL-3.0 on code; data licence ambiguous (GPL repo, CC-BY-derived content) - ask author before redistributing in the site; attribution to Cleland and Chamberlain.

name: Urdatorn/aristophanis-cantica - all 78 responding Aristophanic songs, scanned
contents: 78 antistrophic/polystrophic cantica with syllable-level scansion in custom XML (data/compiled); follows Parker's edition for corrupt responsion.
licence: GNU GPL-3.0 (GitHub licence field); README: 'This repository, however, is under the copyleft GNU GPL 3 license'.
value_why: Comic lyric, outside archaic lyric focus; useful only as responsion test data.
restrictions: GPL-3.0 copyleft on any derived dataset.

name: Norma Syllabarum Graecarum - gold benchmark for Greek syllabification and syllable weight
contents: Hand-marked benchmark: [heavy] and {light} syllables for 16 authors incl. Alcman Louvre Partheneion 36-49, Pindar Pythian 4, Bacchylides 5, Aristophanes 78 songs, Homer, Sophocles, Euripides, Nonnus, prose authors; deliberately excludes texts in the Hypotactic corpus.
licence: GNU GPL-3.0 (GitHub licence field)
value_why: Independent gold test set (includes Alcman and Pindar P4) to measure Melos scansion/syllabification; small and instantly usable.
restrictions: GPL-3.0; use as evaluation data (not shipped in site) to avoid copyleft questions.

name: Urdatorn/grc-macronizer (+ grc-macronizer-oga) - automatic vowel length for alpha/iota/upsilon
contents: Python tool marking dichronic vowel length in Ancient Greek text using odyCy and lexical sources; companion repo macronizes Opera Graeca Adnotata using its annotations. Described as 'the first software to automatically mark the vowel length'.
licence: GNU GPL-3.0 (GitHub licence field)
value_why: Dichronic vowel length is the main blocker for automatic scansion of lyric; Melos already holds odyCy and OGA.
effort_why: Python 3.12 venv needed; GPL-3.0 licensing of any bundled output must be considered.
restrictions: GPL-3.0. Model accuracy not independently verified by me.

name: Anna Conser - Greek-Poetry and greek_scansion (accentual responsion, scanner, trimeter)
contents: Python modules: Greek_Prosody (accents, syllables, scanner, trimeter), Analysis (stanza alignment by syllable to compare accentual melodies of lyric stanzas). Also aconser/greek_scansion (2018) and preprocess_greek_text.
licence: MIT (LICENSE.txt: 'Copyright (c) 2022 Anna Conser ... Permission is hereby granted, free of charge')
value_why: Permissive-licence prosody code (basis of WashU drama scansion and of Urdatorn's responsio tools); no corpus though.
effort_why: Code 'designed to function on my personal computer'; tragic-author CSV corpus not included.
restrictions: README: corpus not uploaded 'out of concern for copyright, but I am willing to investigate the sharing of data if contacted privately.' Owner action: optional permission email to Anna Conser (University of Cincinnati) for her tragic-author scanned corpus.

name: Meters of Greek Drama database (Timothy Moore, WashU) + Lourenco-based scansion
contents: TEI XML hand-checked scansion with cola/metra/period tagging for Euripides Elektra, Hekabe, Orestes only (as of June 2026); Raw_XML for more Euripides; Lourenco meters spreadsheets and meterscomplete.json in the Bitbucket repo.
size: Bitbucket repo about 33.8 MB; 3 hand-checked plays
licence: Site: 'This database is made available under a Creative Commons Attribution-Share Alike License.' and 'This license does not extend to previous publications that may still be subject to copyright protection.' Bitbucket repos: no licence stated.
value_why: Tragic lyric responsion data only for 3 plays; not archaic lyric.
restrictions: CC BY-SA 4.0 on database; Lourenco-derived spreadsheets may carry the publication's copyright (site disclaimer). Contact Tim Moore (tmoore26 at wustl.edu per site) if wanting more plays.

name: MoPSoS - Database of Ancient Greek Morphology, Phonology, Syntax and Scansion
contents: Static site with in-browser SQLite (assets/data/corpus.sqlite.gz); scansion taken from Chamberlain's Hypotactic, morphology/syntax from Perseus treebank; dactylic hexameter views (Iliad, Odyssey, Hymns, Hesiod etc.).
size: repo not measured; work in progress (2026)
licence: README: 'The code is licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0' and 'The data are licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0.'
value_why: Hexameter only so far and a derivative of Hypotactic and Perseus - no new lyric data.
effort_why: Would be redundant with the Hypotactic mirror.
restrictions: CC BY-SA 4.0 share-alike on data; site itself states no licence.

name: Schumann/Beierle/Bloessner greek_scansion - finite-state hexameter scanner
contents: Python library, 32 hexameter variants, evaluation scripts; dataset registered at TIB DOI 10.57702/wexpiptl (page behind a bot check, not read).
licence: README: 'The project is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike license.' (GitHub detects NOASSERTION)
value_why: Hexameter only and NonCommercial.
restrictions: NC - cannot go into a public site if monetised; avoid.

name: Other open-source Greek scanners (diorisisscan, Odikon 2.0, GreekScansion, ancient-greek-verse-to-music-composer)
contents: alevatri/diorisisscan (beta 0.3, Sept 2026, scans Ancient Greek metre); storey/Odikon_2.0 (iambic trimeter and more); jakebohman/Ancient-Greek-Scansion-Tool (hexameter desktop app); Leo-Y-Zhang/GreekScansion (hexameter, certificate-style output).
licence: diorisisscan MIT; Odikon_2.0 MIT; Ancient-Greek-Scansion-Tool MIT; GreekScansion: README badge 'licence-proprietary source-available' (GitHub NOASSERTION).
value_why: Tools not data; useful as second opinions to cross-check Melos scansion.
effort_why: Each has different input format and dependencies.
restrictions: Do not use GreekScansion (proprietary). I did not run any of them.

name: sasansom/sedes and breaking-hermanns-bridge - hexameter sedes/caesura stylometry (Sansom, Fifield)
contents: Pipeline measuring metrical position in Greek hexameter over Homer, Hesiod, Homeric Hymns, Callimachus Hymns, Apollonius, Aratus, Theocritus, Nonnus, Quintus; source TEI from a canonical-greekLit fork.
licence: No licence file (GitHub licence endpoint returns 404 for sasansom/sedes).
value_why: Hexameter only; no lyric.
effort_why: Needs CLTK 1.1.7 and models; output is analysis, not text.
restrictions: No licence stated - treat as all rights reserved until author confirms.

name: theodevi/metre-greek-tragedy - metre of Classical Greek drama (dissertation dataset)
contents: JSON datasets (character_metres.json 115 KB, character_data.json), Perseus/DraCor source folders, and a rule-based metre-detection code folder with manually evaluated test sets from Dale and West.
licence: No licence stated (GitHub: none)
value_why: Trimeter-level tragic data, not lyric.
restrictions: No licence - would need author permission (owner action only if wanted).

name: Older hexameter analysers with no licence (epilanthanomai/hexameter, homermultitext/hexameter, Hexameter.jl, francescomambrini/greek_metre)
contents: Libraries/pilot annotation of Euripides Medea trimeters (2017) and Homeric hexameter analysers (2014-2025).
licence: No licence stated for any of these (GitHub licence: none)
value_why: Superseded by the CC-BY Hypotactic data.
restrictions: No licence - do not reuse.

name: CLTK (Classical Language Toolkit) - Greek prosody support
contents: Current master tree contains only scripts/scan_iambic_trimeter.py under prosody-like paths; I found no Greek scansion module. SCS review says CLTK 'includes basic scansion functions'.
licence: MIT (GitHub licence field)
value_why: No usable Greek scansion data.
restrictions: MIT.

name: Dactylo (Schoisswohl and Papakitsos) and Hexameter.co
contents: Dactylo: tool that scanned eight hexameter epics including Iliad and Odyssey and profiles them; Hexameter.co: practice site for scansion. Neither page links a downloadable dataset.
licence: Article page shows no licence text (a search-result summary claimed CC BY 3.0 for the article, not verified by me); no licence for Dactylo software found; Hexameter.co page returned only its title.
value_why: Hexameter profiling only; no released data located.
restrictions: Licence unknown.

name: Public-domain English metre manuals on Internet Archive (Schmidt/White 1878, Goodell 1901, Smyth Greek Melic Poets 1900)
contents: Schmidt, Introduction to the Rhythmic and Metric of the Classical Languages (trans. W. Prescott White, 1878; ids introductiontorh00schm, introductiontorh00schmuoft); Goodell, Chapters on Greek Metric (1901; chaptersongreekm00gooduoft, cu31924021604388); Smyth, Greek Melic Poets (1900; greekmelicpoets00smytuoft) with metre introduction and notes.
licence: Internet Archive metadata carries no licence field for these items; publication dates 1878-1901. Public-domain-by-age is my assessment, not a statement on the item pages.
value_why: Citable PD reference for metrical terminology and colon names (glyconic, dactylo-epitrite, Aeolic) for the reader's help text; Smyth gives metre per poet.
effort_why: OCR needs cleanup; Greek in OCR is poor.
restrictions: Reference only; no machine-readable metre data.

name: Public-domain German metre handbooks on Internet Archive (J.H.H. Schmidt 1871, Westphal 1865-67, Leo 1901)
contents: Griechische Metrik von J. H. Heinrich Schmidt (1871); Allgemeine griechische Metrik (1865); Metrik der Griechen im Vereine mit den uebrigen musischen Kuensten (Westphal, 1867); Friedrich Leo, Roemische und griechische Metrik (1901).
licence: Internet Archive metadata licenseurl: 'http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/' (Public Domain Mark) for bub_gb_iWZgxM0DmZEC and the other bub_gb items; creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/ for leofriedrichmetrik1901.
value_why: Historic colometry (Westphal, Schmidt) of Pindar and lyric; useful for colon names, not data.
restrictions: None stated beyond PD mark.

name: Zenodo-hosted historic Classical Review articles on Greek lyric metre (1892, 1900) tagged CC0
contents: 'On the Study of Greek Lyric Metre' (1892) and 'A New System of Analysing Greek Lyric Stanzas' (1900); several other 1890s-1920s Classical Review notes on lyric.
licence: Zenodo record licence field: cc-zero (publication dates 1892 and 1900).
value_why: Historic discussion of lyric metre; not data.
restrictions: Reference only.

name: Copyright metre reference works: West Greek Metre, Dale Lyric Metres, Maas Greek Metre, Snell, Lourenco Lyric Metres of Euripidean Drama, Parker Songs of Aristophanes
contents: Standard modern metrical analyses of Greek lyric; the WashU project and the Urdatorn tools use Lourenco and Parker as references.
licence: No open licence located for any of them in this survey; I did not search for each publisher's terms.
value_why: Cannot be ingested; listed so nobody re-searches.
restrictions: Treat as in copyright.

name: Pedecerto / Musisque Deoque (MQDQ)
contents: Latin poetry corpus with Pedecerto scansion of about 259,000 dactylic verses (Latin only); 'Hellenica' listed as a prototype corpus.
licence: Footer: 'Non ne e consentito alcun uso a scopi commerciali se non previo accordo'; 'E vietato ogni genere di mirroring'; reproduction allowed for 'scientific, teaching or documentary use' if unaltered. Pedecerto catalogue entry lists licence as unknown.
value_why: Latin, no open Greek equivalent, no download.
restrictions: Non-commercial, no mirroring, no harvesting without agreement.

name: Henriksson (Helsinki) Greek metre data tool and Palatine Anthology Book 1 metrical dataset
contents: 2016 news: open-source tool for storing/publishing Greek metrical data with ~1,500 annotations (no repo link given). JOHD 2026 paper: xlsx + csv hyphenation of 123 Palatine Anthology Book 1 epigrams (hexameter, elegiac, dodecasyllable).
licence: Helsinki page: 'My project is open-source' (no licence named). JOHD page: 'This work is licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 License.' (article; dataset licence not separately stated).
value_why: Helsinki tool status unknown since 2016; Palatine Anthology is late and out of scope.
restrictions: Unknown.

name: Wikidata (items, properties, lexemes)
contents: Structured data on Greek authors and works (birth/death/floruit, occupation, external IDs). SPARQL check today: 4,616 items with an LGPN ID (P1838) and 15,219 items with a Pleiades ID (P1584).
licence: 'All structured data (i.e. the main, Property, Lexeme, and EntitySchema namespaces) is released into the public domain' under Creative Commons Zero.
value_why: CC0 hub linking Melos authors to LGPN, Pleiades, VIAF, TLG-type IDs and dates; Melos already holds 55 author dates.
effort_why: SPARQL with User-Agent; extend existing 55-author pull to places/works.
restrictions: CC0. Wikidata dates for archaic poets are often century-level or disputed; mark as 'Wikidata'.

name: Wikidata lexemes for Ancient Greek (Q35497)
contents: Lexemes with senses/forms in grc. SPARQL count today: 11,628 Ancient Greek lexemes.
licence: Lexeme namespace 'released into the public domain' under Creative Commons Zero.
value_why: Small; Melos already has 68k Wiktionary entries.
restrictions: CC0.

name: Pleiades gazetteer of ancient places
contents: Ancient places with names, locations, time periods and connections; JSON (preferred), CSV, KML, RDF/Turtle; quarterly releases (latest 4.1, 28 May 2025) on GitHub, Zenodo, NYU, Archive.org.
licence: 'Copyright (c) The Contributors.' and 'Sharing and remixing permitted under terms of the Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 License (cc-by).'
value_why: Place names in lyric (Lesbos, Sparta, Thebes) can link to coordinates and periods; Wikidata already bridges IDs.
restrictions: CC BY 3.0 attribution; project asks to cite numbered releases.

name: PeriodO period gazetteer
contents: Scholarly definitions of periods (e.g. Archaic, Classical, Hellenistic) with source, date range and place; JSON, Turtle, CSV dumps at n2t.net/ark:/99152/p0dataset.*
licence: 'the contributors have dedicated the PeriodO dataset to the public domain by waiving all of their rights to the work worldwide under copyright law ... You can copy, modify, and distribute this dataset, even for commercial purposes'
value_why: Cite which definition of 'Archaic' etc. Melos uses; nice-to-have for period labels.
restrictions: None (public domain dedication; attribution requested but not required).

name: ToposText downloads (places and text-library metadata)
contents: Places KMZ/GeoJSON (5.6 MB), Pelagios Turtle gazetteer with Pleiades/DARE equivalences (5.4 MB), places with citations from ancient texts (JSON-LD, 9 MB), Dublin Core works list (1.1 MB, Nov 2025).
licence: 'Linked Open Data Files for use with appropriate attribution to ToposText' (no named licence). Site notes some texts are used 'by permission of the translator'.
value_why: Place-citation index could map lyric place names to sources; licence is informal.
restrictions: Attribution to ToposText; no formal licence - ask before redistribution.

name: LGPN - Lexicon of Greek Personal Names
contents: Names, places, dates and references for persons across the Greek world 500 BC - 600 AD; online search and an API (search.lgpn.ox.ac.uk/api.html, not readable today: timeouts).
size: not stated; Wikidata holds 4,616 LGPN IDs
licence: CONFLICT: Open Digital Epigraphy Hub record lists 'CC BY 4.0 International'; Oxford ORA deposit says 'Researchers are welcome to use the data for their own purposes but should acknowledge the original source' and 're-use should not be for commercial purposes.' The LGPN site footer shows only a 'Copyright' link (page not found).
value_why: Dating and distribution of names that appear in lyric (e.g. address names, patronymics); no author dates.
effort_why: No dump; API terms unread; licence unresolved.
restrictions: Owner action: email lgpn@classics.ox.ac.uk (address on site) to ask whether bulk or API use is permitted and which licence applies.

name: Trismegistos (Data Services: Tex, Geo, People)
contents: Open APIs and table dumps: TexRelations Matcher, GeoRelations Matcher, GeoResponder, Geo RDF and table dump, PerResponder (JSON), PerRDF. Authors database (8,725 authors / 19,834 works per search summary) is NOT in the listed data services.
licence: 'We offer you open access to our data on a CC BY-SA 4.0 license.' (Data Services page; Authors/People terms page returned 404)
value_why: Egypt/papyri oriented; no dump of Authors; little lyric payoff beyond text-ID cross-matching.
effort_why: Per-ID API only; TLS certificate on the site fails verification in some clients.
restrictions: CC BY-SA 4.0 for the listed services; Authors dataset has no stated open licence.

name: TLG Canon of Greek Authors and Works (stephanus/kasia.tlg.uci.edu)
contents: Authors/works with TLG numbers, century-level dates, epithets, genre; the online Canon is described as about 10,000 works / 2,000 authors.
licence: 'You may browse and search the TLG materials on this site but you may not download them.' and 'TLG materials are copyrighted and are NOT in the public domain.' and 'intended for non-commercial scholarly use'
value_why: Best canonical author dating, but unusable.
restrictions: Do not scrape or copy. Use Wikidata, Perseus catalog and Opera Graeca Adnotata instead.

name: Smith, Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology (Perseus TEI, canonical-pdlrefwk)
contents: All 3 volumes (Smith 1873 printing) as one TEI-XML file with automatically tagged dates and citations; entries for Alcman, Archilochus, Sappho, Pindar, etc. Digital Classicist notes dates and citations are auto-tagged with varying accuracy.
licence: GitHub CC-BY-SA-4.0; README: 'Unless otherwise indicated, all contents of this repository are licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International License.' (The Digital Classicist page for the entry says 'Content is available under Creative Commons Attribution'.)
value_why: Public-domain-era biographies with ancient testimonia and dates for every lyric poet - good for author info cards.
restrictions: CC BY-SA 4.0 (share-alike). Victorian scholarship: dates and facts outdated; label as 'Smith 1873'.

name: Suda On Line (SOL), translations of the Suda
contents: Adler-numbered Suda entries with English translation and notes (biographical entries on poets); no bulk download found.
licence: Covered by a Creative Commons 'Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike' licence (rights page). Citing and quoting allowed for non-commercial purposes with credit.
value_why: Ancient biographical testimony for lyric poets.
effort_why: No bulk download; Greek base text from Adler via TLG (status of that text unclear).
restrictions: NC-SA; no dump; do not scrape.

name: Pauly-Wissowa Realencyclopaedie on German Wikisource
contents: Full text of RE articles that are out of copyright; each article page states the year it becomes free (e.g. 2030, 2038 for later articles).
licence: Per-article public-domain status shown on each page; Wikisource terms apply to transcriptions.
value_why: Early volumes (A-Q era) may have poet articles; later ones not yet free.
effort_why: Article-by-article rights check and German text.
restrictions: Check each page's date notice; I verified only the mechanism, not any poet article.

name: SNAP:DRGN prosopography standard (ontology and cookbook)
contents: RDF ontology and recommendations for interchange of ancient prosopographies. The central triplestore (about 650,000 records) no longer runs; no central dump found.
licence: Ontology: CC0-1.0 (GitHub); Cookbook: Apache-2.0 (GitHub)
value_why: A schema, not people data.
restrictions: None.

name: Persons of Ancient Athens (Traill, Univ. of Toronto)
contents: Searchable Athenian prosopography; online search covers about 10,000 names (letters beta to delta etc.).
licence: No terms retrieved (site returned a human-verification page); not stated.
value_why: Athens only, partial, no dump.
restrictions: Unknown - unverified.

name: iDAI.chronontology and Kerameikos.org (period / pottery thesauri)
contents: ChronOntology: linked-data time periods; Kerameikos: ceramic LOD thesaurus (kerameikos/data on GitHub).
licence: ChronOntology page links to the CC BY 4.0 licence page (no sentence stating it); kerameikos/data GitHub licence ODbL-1.0.
value_why: Archaeological dating vocabularies, little text relevance.
restrictions: ODbL share-alike for Kerameikos; ChronOntology licence only implied by a link.

name: HGV / papyri.info idp.data (dates of papyri)
contents: Integrating Digital Papyrology data incl. HGV metadata (dates, provenance) and DCLP literary papyri.
licence: README: 'This data is made available under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 License, with copyright and attribution to the respective projects.'
value_why: Melos already holds 175 lyric DCLP files from this repo; HGV dates give papyrus-copy dates for those witnesses.
restrictions: CC BY 3.0, credit each sub-project.

name: Ithaca (DeepMind) and I.PHI inscription dating
contents: Model for restoring, dating and placing Greek inscriptions; trained on PHI 'Searchable Greek Inscriptions' (78,608 inscriptions in I.PHI).
licence: Code: Apache-2.0 (search summary of repo); PHI data terms restrict re-use (Digital Classicist wiki, around 2020-21); I.PHI licence not read.
value_why: Inscriptions, not literary lyric.
restrictions: PHI re-use not permitted per wiki; avoid.

name: Open Ancient Greek WordNet 0.5 (CNR-ILC, Boschetti, Del Gratta, Diakoff)
contents: wn-data-grc.tab: 7,447 synsets, 22,420 lemmas, 76,620 senses mapped to Princeton WordNet 3.0 (filtered by Latin WordNet IDs); mirror in OMW tab format at TommasoPetrolito/wn-data-grc.tab (file 3.46 MB).
licence: CLARIN-IT record: 'Creative Commons - Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-SA 4.0)'; GitHub README: 'License: Creative Commons Attribution Share-Alike 4.0 International'.
value_why: Gives English WordNet concept links for 22k lemmas; 'estimated precision ~56%' and bootstrapped from LSJ/Middle Liddell/Autenrieth which Melos already holds.
restrictions: CC BY-SA 4.0. README disclaimer: 'The current version 0.5 has not yet been manually corrected; the estimated precision is low.' Not part of Open Multilingual Wordnet (omw-data has only modern Greek).

name: Ancient Greek WordNet (CHS Harvard, ongoing edition)
contents: REST API (JSON) for lemmas, synsets, lemmatisation and translation; manually curated extension of the CNR-ILC work from Mycenaean/Homeric Greek onwards. Helper library jcuenod/greekwordnet (GPL-3.0).
licence: No licence or terms stated; page footer says '(c) 2026 Center for Hellenic Studies.'
value_why: Hand-curated senses for Homeric and later Greek would help semantic search.
restrictions: Owner action: email greekwordnet@chs.harvard.edu to ask for a data dump and licence. Do not crawl the API until answered.

name: UBS Dictionary of the Greek New Testament (Semantic Dictionary, Louw-Nida-derived domains)
contents: Lexical analysis, definitions, glosses, references and lexical semantic domains for Greek NT words in XML and JSON. The original Louw-Nida lexicon (c) UBS remains commercial.
size: repo 299 MB; dictionaries/greek has JSON and XML
licence: 'These UBS resources have been released, in their entirety, under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-SA 4.0) license.' (GitHub: CC-BY-SA-4.0)
value_why: Koine NT vocabulary only; semantic-domain scheme could inspire categories but few lyric words.
restrictions: CC BY-SA 4.0 with 'Attribution always required'. Melos holds Dodson NT (CC0) already.

name: Ancient Greek word vectors: Stopponi et al. language models (Zenodo 8369516) and Diogenet Fasttext (Zenodo 7630945)
contents: Diachronica and ALP vector-space models of Ancient Greek (2 zips, about 697 MB); Diogenet fasttext/floret CBOW and skipgram embeddings trained on 1 GB of Ancient Greek (19 files, about 14 GB total).
licence: Zenodo licence field: cc-by-4.0 for both records.
value_why: Nearest-neighbour 'related words' for lexicon entries and semantic search.
effort_why: Large; need lemma-level choice and serving.
restrictions: CC BY 4.0 credit; training corpora of each model should be checked for licence compatibility (not verified).

name: Greek semantic benchmarks on Zenodo: AGREE (7681749) and 44-lemma semantic-change benchmark (13364555)
contents: AGREE: benchmark for evaluating semantic models of Ancient Greek (3 files, 436 KB); Stopponi et al.: 44 lemmas that underwent semantic change plus matched stable set (4 KB).
licence: Zenodo licence field: cc-by-4.0 (both records).
value_why: Expert-judged word-relatedness pairs useful to test embeddings; not content for readers.
restrictions: CC BY 4.0.

name: LAGT - Lemmatized Ancient Greek Texts (Kase; Zenodo 13889714) and LSJ-based dictionary for it (Zenodo 15251724)
contents: Parquet of lemmatized Perseus + First1KGreek + GLAUx + early Christian texts (v4.1 latest independent release; about 764 MB); companion LSJ English-definition JSON (22.8 MB).
licence: Zenodo licence field: cc-by-4.0 (both records)
value_why: Overlaps Melos' Perseus/First1K/GLAUx work; useful only as a lemma-frequency cross-check.
effort_why: Large; GLAUx portions have per-text licences (Melos note).
restrictions: Underlying text licences may be stricter than the record's CC BY.

name: ConceptNet (grc edges, Wiktionary-derived)
contents: Related terms, etymology, forms and synonyms for grc nodes; sample node shows about 30 edges; mostly from Wiktionary.
size: whole graph 34M edges (grc share not counted)
licence: 'ConceptNet 5 is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International License.'
value_why: Derived from Wiktionary data Melos already holds.
restrictions: CC BY-SA 4.0.

name: BabelNet
contents: Multilingual semantic network incl. Ancient Greek among selectable languages.
licence: Page titled 'BabelNet Non-Commercial license'; sharing 'only to research institutions' in the research section.
value_why: Non-commercial and redistribution-limited.
restrictions: Do not use.

name: DICES - Database of epic speeches and characters (Finkmann, Forstall, Verhelst)
contents: Metadata on 4,689 speeches, 1,001 characters, 52 poems of Greek and Latin epic; archival CSV/tab export on Borealis (speech.tab 352 KB, character.tab 91 KB, etc.).
licence: Borealis dataset licence field: 'CC-BY 4.0' (doi 10.5683/SP3/N8LS2Y).
value_why: Epic only; no lyric.
restrictions: CC BY 4.0.

name: Chicago Homer / WordHoard (Northwestern)
contents: Homeric formula and concordance database; Chamberlain's blog says Martin Mueller's hexameter scansion is 'tucked away inside WordHoard' (search summary).
licence: 'All materials on this site are copyrighted and are not in the public domain.' Greek texts used by arrangement with Oxford University Press ('without the permission of Oxford University Press'). WordHoard copyright and text-licence pages not retrieved.
value_why: Restricted; Homer only.
restrictions: Do not use.

name: Iconclass classification data
contents: Core Iconclass subject classification (iconography and mythology concepts).
licence: CC0-1.0 (GitHub licence field)
value_why: Mythological concept taxonomy; weak fit with Greek lemmas.
restrictions: None.

name: Greek emotion and sentiment datasets (Pavlopoulos Iliad 1, Boschetti et al., RAGE)
contents: Iliad Book 1 sentiment labels (annotated on modern-Greek translation); Homeric emotion annotation scheme; RAGE Roman and Greek Emotions corpus (about 100,000 words, LREC 2026).
licence: No dataset licence located. ACL Anthology footer says 'Materials published in or after 2016 are licensed on a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License' (applies to the papers).
value_why: No word-level Greek emotion lexicon exists openly; these are annotated corpora only and no download URL found.
restrictions: Licence and availability unknown.

name: PREMOVE - annotated Ancient Greek and Latin preverbed motion verbs (Zenodo 19183131)
contents: 2,835 manually annotated occurrences (1,351 Greek) with lemma, morphology, syntax, semantics, World Historical Gazetteer links and metadata (author, genre, century).
licence: Zenodo licence field: cc-by-4.0
value_why: Narrow verb class.
restrictions: CC BY 4.0.
